title: Looking back on a hectic musical life
summary: Albert says his life in music held everything, that his aim was making others happy, and they discuss people with flimsy excuses.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant
